paragraphs.source_en: Yet at noon, swords were drawn and fighting broke out at the Kyōbashi Gate—something neither side had expected.

units.source_en: Yet at noon, swords were drawn and fighting broke out at the Kyōbashi Gate—something neither side had expected.
units.source_zh: 然而，正午，京桥口却开始动刀动枪，这可是双方意料之外的事。

paragraphs.source_zh: 然而，正午，京桥口却开始动刀动枪，这可是双方意料之外的事。

paragraphs.source_en: Those who struck first claimed they had had no choice. By then Tokugawa Ieyasu had already entered the Sakura Gate, and the appointed hour had passed. But a great crowd still filled the open ground before the Kyōbashi Gate. They were chiefly the elderly, women, and children who had escaped the great fire, together with wounded and disabled soldiers unable to walk—but how could the Kantō men who attacked know how formidable they were?

units.source_en: Those who struck first claimed they had had no choice.
units.source_zh: 先动手的一方，说是不得已。

units.source_en: By then Tokugawa Ieyasu had already entered the Sakura Gate, and the appointed hour had passed.
units.source_zh: 此时德川家康已经进了樱御门，也已过了约定的时辰。

units.source_en: But a great crowd still filled the open ground before the Kyōbashi Gate.
units.source_zh: 但在京桥口前面的四方空地上，仍聚集着大群人。

units.source_en: They were chiefly the elderly, women, and children who had escaped the great fire, together with wounded and disabled soldiers unable to walk—but how could the Kantō men who attacked know how formidable they were?
units.source_zh: 这些人主要是从大火中逃出的老弱妇孺，还有走不了的伤残士兵，但动手的关东一方哪知他们的实力？

paragraphs.source_zh: 先动手的一方，说是不得已。此时德川家康已经进了樱御门，也已过了约定的时辰。但在京桥口前面的四方空地上，仍聚集着大群人。这些人主要是从大火中逃出的老弱妇孺，还有走不了的伤残士兵，但动手的关东一方哪知他们的实力？

paragraphs.source_en: The sound of an explosion shocked all Osaka.

units.source_en: The sound of an explosion shocked all Osaka.
units.source_zh: 爆炸的声音震惊了大坂。

paragraphs.source_zh: 爆炸的声音震惊了大坂。

paragraphs.source_en: “What has happened? That sound…” Hidetada’s face changed as he rose. “Mataemon, go and see!”

units.source_en: “What has happened?
units.source_zh: “发生何事？

units.source_en: That sound…” Hidetada’s face changed as he rose. “Mataemon, go and see!”
units.source_zh: 这声音……”秀忠变了脸色，站起身来，“又右卫门，去看看！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “发生何事？这声音……”秀忠变了脸色，站起身来，“又右卫门，去看看！”

paragraphs.source_en: “At once!”

units.source_en: “At once!”
units.source_zh: “遵命！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “遵命！”

paragraphs.source_en: Yagyū Munenori galloped to the Kyōbashi Gate. On arriving, he saw bodies strewn everywhere in a spectacle too ghastly to behold… There were young women who had died with their bellies cut open, helpless old people and children, monks, and ordinary townsfolk.

units.source_en: Yagyū Munenori galloped to the Kyōbashi Gate.
units.source_zh: 柳生宗矩飞马赶到了京桥口。

units.source_en: On arriving, he saw bodies strewn everywhere in a spectacle too ghastly to behold… There were young women who had died with their bellies cut open, helpless old people and children, monks, and ordinary townsfolk.

ja.t: いてみると、おびただしい

units.source_zh: 他一到，已见偌多尸体横七竖八倒于地上，其状惨不忍睹……有被切开腹部而死的年轻女子，也有手无缚鸡之力的老人幼童，有僧人，也有市井百姓。

paragraphs.source_zh: 柳生宗矩飞马赶到了京桥口。他一到，已见偌多尸体横七竖八倒于地上，其状惨不忍睹……有被切开腹部而死的年轻女子，也有手无缚鸡之力的老人幼童，有僧人，也有市井百姓。

paragraphs.source_en: Even then, bare-chested warriors were continuing their frenzied slaughter.

units.source_en: Even then, bare-chested warriors were continuing their frenzied slaughter.
units.source_zh: 此时，赤裸着上身的武士依旧在疯狂地屠杀。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，赤裸着上身的武士依旧在疯狂地屠杀。

paragraphs.source_en: “Stop! Stop! You beasts!” Mataemon roared. Suddenly he noticed another man who had also drawn his sword and appeared to be trying to stop the massacre.

units.source_en: “Stop!
units.source_zh: “住手！

units.source_en: Stop!
units.source_zh: 住手！

units.source_en: You beasts!”
units.source_zh: 你们这些畜生！”

めようとしているらしい

units.source_zh: 又右卫门怒吼着，猛地，他发现还有一个人也拔出了武刀，似欲阻止屠杀。

paragraphs.source_zh: “住手！住手！你们这些畜生！”又右卫门怒吼着，猛地，他发现还有一个人也拔出了武刀，似欲阻止屠杀。

paragraphs.source_en: “What—Okuhara Shinjūrō?” Yagyū Mataemon could not help rubbing his eyes. He had assumed Shinjūrō would—and must—remain beside Hideyori and his mother. Why, then, was he here?

units.source_en: “What—Okuhara Shinjūrō?”
units.source_zh: “啊，奥原信十郎？”

units.source_en: Yagyū Mataemon could not help rubbing his eyes.
units.source_zh: 柳生又右卫门不由得擦了擦眼睛。

units.source_en: He had assumed Shinjūrō would—and must—remain beside Hideyori and his mother. Why, then, was he here?

ja.t: っていなければならないはずだった。それなのに、なぜここにいるのか。

units.source_zh: 他原本以为，信十郎定会留在秀赖母子身边，亦须留在他们身边，但如今怎会在这里？

paragraphs.source_zh: “啊，奥原信十郎？”柳生又右卫门不由得擦了擦眼睛。他原本以为，信十郎定会留在秀赖母子身边，亦须留在他们身边，但如今怎会在这里？

paragraphs.source_en: Still loudly berating the maddened warriors, Munenori approached the man who closely resembled Shinjūrō and asked, “Is that you, Okuhara?”

units.source_en: Still loudly berating the maddened warriors, Munenori approached the man who closely resembled Shinjūrō and asked, “Is that you, Okuhara?”
units.source_zh: 宗矩一边大声斥责着疯狂的武士，一边靠近那颇似信十郎的人，道：“可是奥原？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 宗矩一边大声斥责着疯狂的武士，一边靠近那颇似信十郎的人，道：“可是奥原？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Mm…” the other man answered softly.

units.source_en: “Mm…” the other man answered softly.
units.source_zh: “唔……”对方轻轻应了一声。

paragraphs.source_zh: “唔……”对方轻轻应了一声。

paragraphs.source_en: “What happened? Have you already entrusted Hideyori and his mother to the Lord Ōgosho?”

units.source_en: “What happened?
units.source_zh: “发生了何事？

units.source_en: Have you already entrusted Hideyori and his mother to the Lord Ōgosho?”
units.source_zh: 已经将秀赖母子交与大御所了？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “发生了何事？已经将秀赖母子交与大御所了？”

paragraphs.source_en: Without answering, the man turned and plunged with a splash into the moat beside the stone wall.

units.source_en: Without answering, the man turned and plunged with a splash into the moat beside the stone wall.
units.source_zh: 那人不答，转身扑通跳进了石垣边的护城河。

paragraphs.source_zh: 那人不答，转身扑通跳进了石垣边的护城河。

paragraphs.source_en: Mataemon cried out in surprise. Across the smoke-shrouded water, a small boat sped away. Shinjūrō had come by boat—but why? Preoccupied with stopping the slaughter before him, Yagyū Munenori had no time to think it through. He still trusted Shinjūrō completely and felt entirely at ease about the granary at Ashida Garden.

units.source_en: Mataemon cried out in surprise.
units.source_zh: 又右卫门惊呼一声。

units.source_en: Across the smoke-shrouded water, a small boat sped away.
units.source_zh: 烟雾笼罩的水面上，一叶小舟急速驶了出去。

units.source_en: Shinjūrō had come by boat—but why? Preoccupied with stopping the slaughter before him, Yagyū Munenori had no time to think it through.
units.source_zh: 信十郎是坐船来的，这是为何……柳生宗矩为了制止眼前的屠杀，无暇仔细思量。

units.source_en: He still trusted Shinjūrō completely and felt entirely at ease about the granary at Ashida Garden.
units.source_zh: 他仍对信十郎十足信任，也对芦田苑的谷仓十分放心。

paragraphs.source_zh: 又右卫门惊呼一声。烟雾笼罩的水面上，一叶小舟急速驶了出去。信十郎是坐船来的，这是为何……柳生宗矩为了制止眼前的屠杀，无暇仔细思量。他仍对信十郎十足信任，也对芦田苑的谷仓十分放心。

paragraphs.source_en: In fact, the man was indeed Okuhara Shinjūrō.

units.source_en: In fact, the man was indeed Okuhara Shinjūrō.
units.source_zh: 其实，那人正是奥原信十郎。

paragraphs.source_zh: 其实，那人正是奥原信十郎。

paragraphs.source_en: Okuhara Shinjūrō had reacted just as Munenori had. When a servant reported the grave emergency at the Kyōbashi Gate, he knew something was wrong. Yet the granary was restless at the time as well, and he dared not relax his vigilance in the slightest. Still, if disorder broke out at the Kyōbashi Gate, it would inevitably block the outlet of the water channel, rendering useless the escape route he had prepared for the worst.

units.source_en: Okuhara Shinjūrō had reacted just as Munenori had.
units.source_zh: 奥原信十郎也和宗矩一样。

units.source_en: When a servant reported the grave emergency at the Kyōbashi Gate, he knew something was wrong.

ja.t: らされ、まずいことになったと

units.source_zh: 他听到一个下人禀报了京桥口的危急事态，心想不妙。

units.source_en: Yet the granary was restless at the time as well, and he dared not relax his vigilance in the slightest.

ja.t: することはできなかった。

units.source_zh: 但当时的谷仓内也躁动不安，他不敢有丝毫疏忽。

units.source_en: Still, if disorder broke out at the Kyōbashi Gate, it would inevitably block the outlet of the water channel, rendering useless the escape route he had prepared for the worst.
units.source_zh: 只是，京桥口若发生骚乱，必堵住引水渠的出口，他预备的在最坏情形下逃生的办法也就没了用处。

paragraphs.source_zh: 奥原信十郎也和宗矩一样。他听到一个下人禀报了京桥口的危急事态，心想不妙。但当时的谷仓内也躁动不安，他不敢有丝毫疏忽。只是，京桥口若发生骚乱，必堵住引水渠的出口，他预备的在最坏情形下逃生的办法也就没了用处。

paragraphs.source_en: Only when he heard Munenori’s startled cry did he abruptly regain his composure. When he came to himself, what he heard was no longer the wailing at the Kyōbashi Gate, but gunfire from Ashida Garden…

units.source_en: Only when he heard Munenori’s startled cry did he abruptly regain his composure.
units.source_zh: 听到宗矩的惊叫，他才猛地恢复了冷静。

units.source_en: When he came to himself, what he heard was no longer the wailing at the Kyōbashi Gate, but gunfire from Ashida Garden…
units.source_zh: 回过神来，他听到的已不再是京桥口的悲鸣，而是芦田苑的枪声……

paragraphs.source_zh: 听到宗矩的惊叫，他才猛地恢复了冷静。回过神来，他听到的已不再是京桥口的悲鸣，而是芦田苑的枪声……

paragraphs.source_en: Disaster! Okuhara Shinjūrō bit down hard on his lip in the boat. He had never even imagined what might happen during his absence. He understood that the Ii troops, who had suffered in the previous day’s battle, would surely seek revenge; they all hated Hideyori and his mother to the marrow.

units.source_en: Disaster!
units.source_zh: 坏了！

units.source_en: Okuhara Shinjūrō bit down hard on his lip in the boat.
units.source_zh: 奥原信十郎在小船上使劲咬着嘴唇。

units.source_en: He had never even imagined what might happen during his absence.

ja.t: えたことさえなかった。

units.source_zh: 自己离开的这段时间到底发生了什么，他连想都不曾想过。

units.source_en: He understood that the Ii troops, who had suffered in the previous day’s battle, would surely seek revenge; they all hated Hideyori and his mother to the marrow.
units.source_zh: 他明白，昨日一战中吃了亏的井伊军，必会报复，他们皆对秀赖母子恨之入骨。

paragraphs.source_zh: 坏了！奥原信十郎在小船上使劲咬着嘴唇。自己离开的这段时间到底发生了什么，他连想都不曾想过。他明白，昨日一战中吃了亏的井伊军，必会报复，他们皆对秀赖母子恨之入骨。

paragraphs.source_en: But when Shinjūrō moored the boat beneath the willows beside the privy, the Ii troops had already surrounded the granary. The granary was utterly silent, with no sign of life. A chill instantly ran down his spine.

units.source_en: But when Shinjūrō moored the boat beneath the willows beside the privy, the Ii troops had already surrounded the granary.
units.source_zh: 但，当信十郎将小船停到茅厕旁的柳荫下时，井伊军已包围了谷仓。

units.source_en: The granary was utterly silent, with no sign of life.
units.source_zh: 谷仓内一片寂静，不见任何生气。

units.source_en: A chill instantly ran down his spine.
units.source_zh: 他顿时感到脊背发凉。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但，当信十郎将小船停到茅厕旁的柳荫下时，井伊军已包围了谷仓。谷仓内一片寂静，不见任何生气。他顿时感到脊背发凉。

paragraphs.source_en: “There—we’ve arrived!”

units.source_en: “There—we’ve arrived!”
units.source_zh: “好，到了！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “好，到了！”

paragraphs.source_en: Shinjūrō heard the servant’s trembling voice, but stood frozen and motionless. It was all over! Someone seemed to have seized that brief opening and reduced all his painstaking efforts to nothing. Had those inside the granary been massacred, or had they taken their own lives? Grief brought him to the verge of tears. Drawing a breath, he sprang into the granary—he had to see with his own eyes that no one remained alive.

units.source_en: Shinjūrō heard the servant’s trembling voice, but stood frozen and motionless.
units.source_zh: 信十郎听到下人颤抖的声音，却像冻住了一般，纹丝不动。

units.source_en: It was all over!
units.source_zh: 都完了！

units.source_en: Someone seemed to have seized that brief opening and reduced all his painstaking efforts to nothing.

ja.t: にしてしまったらしい。

units.source_zh: 似是有人乘了这个小小的空隙，使他的苦心全都化为了泡影。

units.source_en: Had those inside the granary been massacred, or had they taken their own lives?
units.source_zh: 仓内众人是被残杀了，还是自杀？

units.source_en: Grief brought him to the verge of tears. Drawing a breath, he sprang into the granary—he had to see with his own eyes that no one remained alive.
units.source_zh: 他悲苦欲泪，吸一口气，一跃冲进了谷仓——他要亲眼确认已无活口。

paragraphs.source_zh: 信十郎听到下人颤抖的声音，却像冻住了一般，纹丝不动。都完了！似是有人乘了这个小小的空隙，使他的苦心全都化为了泡影。仓内众人是被残杀了，还是自杀？他悲苦欲泪，吸一口气，一跃冲进了谷仓——他要亲眼确认已无活口。

paragraphs.source_en: Heavens! Before his eyes lay dozens of blood-soaked corpses, terrible and solemn beyond words. Mastering his anguish, he poured lamp oil over the straw mats and piles of grain; a tilt of the wick, and flames leapt up. Then, from the corner of his eye, he saw the Ii troops charge in with murderous fury.

units.source_en: Heavens!
units.source_zh: 天！

units.source_en: Before his eyes lay dozens of blood-soaked corpses, terrible and solemn beyond words.
units.source_zh: 映入他眼帘的，是几十具被血染红的尸体，说不出的惨烈静穆。

units.source_en: Mastering his anguish, he poured lamp oil over the straw mats and piles of grain; a tilt of the wick, and flames leapt up.
units.source_zh: 他忍痛将灯油倒到草席和谷堆上，灯芯一倾，大火腾起。

units.source_en: Then, from the corner of his eye, he saw the Ii troops charge in with murderous fury.
units.source_zh: 此后，他以眼角的余光窥见井伊军杀气腾腾冲了进来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天！映入他眼帘的，是几十具被血染红的尸体，说不出的惨烈静穆。他忍痛将灯油倒到草席和谷堆上，灯芯一倾，大火腾起。此后，他以眼角的余光窥见井伊军杀气腾腾冲了进来。

paragraphs.source_en: Shinjūrō had no chance to escape, so he lay down between Hideyori and Lady Yodo and pretended to be a corpse. Though numb with shock, his composed series of actions had not been planned beforehand; they arose solely from the desperation of the moment.

units.source_en: Shinjūrō had no chance to escape, so he lay down between Hideyori and Lady Yodo and pretended to be a corpse.
units.source_zh: 信十郎已无隙逃走，他只好趴在秀赖和淀夫人中间，装成一具死尸。

units.source_en: Though numb with shock, his composed series of actions had not been planned beforehand; they arose solely from the desperation of the moment.

ja.t: えていたものではなく、

units.source_zh: 茫然若失的他一系列沉着的行动，绝非先时想好，只是一时情急使然。

paragraphs.source_zh: 信十郎已无隙逃走，他只好趴在秀赖和淀夫人中间，装成一具死尸。茫然若失的他一系列沉着的行动，绝非先时想好，只是一时情急使然。

paragraphs.source_en: By the time Ii Naotaka and Honda Masazumi entered, he had already mingled with Ii’s rank-and-file soldiers and was ceaselessly carrying bodies outside and washing away bloodstains. Flames and smoke could conceal his figure, but not the desolation in his heart.

units.source_en: By the time Ii Naotaka and Honda Masazumi entered, he had already mingled with Ii’s rank-and-file soldiers and was ceaselessly carrying bodies outside and washing away bloodstains.
units.source_zh: 在井伊直孝和本多正纯进来的时候，他已经混进了井伊的杂兵之中，不停往外搬运尸体，清洗血迹。

units.source_en: Flames and smoke could conceal his figure, but not the desolation in his heart.

ja.t: すことはできなかった。

units.source_zh: 火焰和烟雾能遮住他的身形，却遮不住他心头的悲凉。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在井伊直孝和本多正纯进来的时候，他已经混进了井伊的杂兵之中，不停往外搬运尸体，清洗血迹。火焰和烟雾能遮住他的身形，却遮不住他心头的悲凉。

paragraphs.source_en: No matter what happened, he would preserve the lives of Hideyori, his wife, and Lady Yodo. That was the vow he had made when he left Okuhara for Osaka Castle—even the conviction he had kept buried in his heart in recent days. Yet that conviction had been crushed to dust because he had left for a single moment.

units.source_en: No matter what happened, he would preserve the lives of Hideyori, his wife, and Lady Yodo. That was the vow he had made when he left Okuhara for Osaka Castle—even the conviction he had kept buried in his heart in recent days.
units.source_zh: 无论怎样，都要保全秀赖夫妇和淀夫人的性命，这是他离开奥原来到大坂城时的誓语，甚至是他近日埋在心中的信念。

units.source_en: Yet that conviction had been crushed to dust because he had left for a single moment.
units.source_zh: 然而，这个信念却因他瞬间的离开而被碾了个粉碎。

paragraphs.source_zh: 无论怎样，都要保全秀赖夫妇和淀夫人的性命，这是他离开奥原来到大坂城时的誓语，甚至是他近日埋在心中的信念。然而，这个信念却因他瞬间的离开而被碾了个粉碎。

paragraphs.source_en: The dozens of bodies were divided into several groups and buried there within Ashida Garden. The supervisors were not Ii Naotaka, but Honda Masazumi and Abe Masatsugu. By the time Doi Toshikatsu hurried over from the camp at Okayama, the area around the granary had been put in order.

units.source_en: The dozens of bodies were divided into several groups and buried there within Ashida Garden.
units.source_zh: 几十具尸体被分成几堆，就地埋在了芦田苑内。

units.source_en: The supervisors were not Ii Naotaka, but Honda Masazumi and Abe Masatsugu.
units.source_zh: 监督之人不是井伊直孝，而是本多正纯和阿部正次二人。

units.source_en: By the time Doi Toshikatsu hurried over from the camp at Okayama, the area around the granary had been put in order.
units.source_zh: 当土井利胜从冈山的军营赶过来时，谷仓四周已收拾干净。

paragraphs.source_zh: 几十具尸体被分成几堆，就地埋在了芦田苑内。监督之人不是井伊直孝，而是本多正纯和阿部正次二人。当土井利胜从冈山的军营赶过来时，谷仓四周已收拾干净。

paragraphs.source_en: The men stood in the fine drizzle, their faces showing either grief or deep emotion. Whenever a corpse was carried from the storehouse on a coarse straw mat, they pressed their palms together and murmured Buddhist prayers.

units.source_en: The men stood in the fine drizzle, their faces showing either grief or deep emotion.
units.source_zh: 众人站在蒙蒙细雨之中，脸上或是沉痛或是感慨。

units.source_en: Whenever a corpse was carried from the storehouse on a coarse straw mat, they pressed their palms together and murmured Buddhist prayers.
units.source_zh: 每当从仓房用粗草席搬出死尸时，他们便会双手合十，口中诵佛。

paragraphs.source_zh: 众人站在蒙蒙细雨之中，脸上或是沉痛或是感慨。每当从仓房用粗草席搬出死尸时，他们便会双手合十，口中诵佛。

paragraphs.source_en: One earthen grave after another rose freshly from the ground, appearing extraordinarily still in the misting rain. The figures around Shinjūrō gradually thinned out. Ii Naotaka, Doi Toshikatsu, Honda Masazumi, Abe Masatsugu, Andō Shigenobu, Aoyama Tadanari, and the others had all disappeared. After victory in the war, they had a mountain of work to do.

units.source_en: One earthen grave after another rose freshly from the ground, appearing extraordinarily still in the misting rain.
units.source_zh: 一座座土坟新堆起来，在蒙蒙细雨中显得格外静谧。

units.source_en: The figures around Shinjūrō gradually thinned out. Ii Naotaka, Doi Toshikatsu, Honda Masazumi, Abe Masatsugu, Andō Shigenobu, Aoyama Tadanari, and the others had all disappeared.
units.source_zh: 信十郎周围的人影逐渐变得稀疏，井伊直孝、土井利胜、本多正纯、阿部正次、安藤重信和青山忠俊等人，都已经不见了踪影。

units.source_en: After victory in the war, they had a mountain of work to do.
units.source_zh: 战争胜利之后，他们要做的事堆积如山。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一座座土坟新堆起来，在蒙蒙细雨中显得格外静谧。信十郎周围的人影逐渐变得稀疏，井伊直孝、土井利胜、本多正纯、阿部正次、安藤重信和青山忠俊等人，都已经不见了踪影。战争胜利之后，他们要做的事堆积如山。

paragraphs.source_en: No one grew suspicious of Shinjūrō for remaining there after the others had left, and that filled him with an indescribable loneliness.

units.source_en: No one grew suspicious of Shinjūrō for remaining there after the others had left, and that filled him with an indescribable loneliness.
units.source_zh: 众人离去，并未因还留在原地的信十郎而生疑，这让他感到了一种难以名状的孤独。

paragraphs.source_zh: 众人离去，并未因还留在原地的信十郎而生疑，这让他感到了一种难以名状的孤独。

paragraphs.source_en: After a long while, a servant named Shinhichi quietly returned to Ashida Garden. Wearing a broad straw hat, he looked anxiously at Shinjūrō and said, “My lord, everyone is waiting on the opposite bank. Please board the boat.”

units.source_en: After a long while, a servant named Shinhichi quietly returned to Ashida Garden. Wearing a broad straw hat, he looked anxiously at Shinjūrō and said, “My lord, everyone is waiting on the opposite bank.
units.source_zh: 良久，一个叫作新七的下人，悄悄回到芦田苑，他头戴斗笠，忧心忡忡望着信十郎，道：“大人，大家都在对岸等着。

units.source_en: Please board the boat.”
units.source_zh: 上船吧。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 良久，一个叫作新七的下人，悄悄回到芦田苑，他头戴斗笠，忧心忡忡望着信十郎，道：“大人，大家都在对岸等着。上船吧。”

paragraphs.source_en: Those words were all it took: Okuhara Shinjūrō burst into loud sobs. Shinhichi held the straw hat over his head and waited silently beside him for the weeping to end. But how could Shinjūrō’s wailing cease in a mere moment?

units.source_en: Those words were all it took: Okuhara Shinjūrō burst into loud sobs.
units.source_zh: 不听则罢，一听此言，奥原信十郎号啕大哭。

units.source_en: Shinhichi held the straw hat over his head and waited silently beside him for the weeping to end.
units.source_zh: 新七取斗笠遮在他头上，默默站于一旁，等他哭完。

units.source_en: But how could Shinjūrō’s wailing cease in a mere moment?
units.source_zh: 但信十郎的号啕哪会片刻就止？

paragraphs.source_zh: 不听则罢，一听此言，奥原信十郎号啕大哭。新七取斗笠遮在他头上，默默站于一旁，等他哭完。但信十郎的号啕哪会片刻就止？

paragraphs.source_en: The rain fell harder and harder, drumming against the straw hat.

units.source_en: The rain fell harder and harder, drumming against the straw hat.
units.source_zh: 雨越来越大了，啪啪击打在斗笠上。

paragraphs.source_zh: 雨越来越大了，啪啪击打在斗笠上。

paragraphs.source_en: Okuhara Shinjūrō wept for about a quarter of an hour, his body trembling, before finally stopping. He looked back at Shinhichi, and in his bloodshot eyes there was once more a faint trace of his usual self.

units.source_en: Okuhara Shinjūrō wept for about a quarter of an hour, his body trembling, before finally stopping.
units.source_zh: 奥原信十郎颤抖着身体，大哭了约莫一刻钟，终停下来。

units.source_en: He looked back at Shinhichi, and in his bloodshot eyes there was once more a faint trace of his usual self.
units.source_zh: 他回头看看新七，充血的双眼里，已可微微见出平时的模样。

paragraphs.source_zh: 奥原信十郎颤抖着身体，大哭了约莫一刻钟，终停下来。他回头看看新七，充血的双眼里，已可微微见出平时的模样。

paragraphs.source_en: Only then did Shinhichi breathe a sigh of relief. “Please board the boat.”

units.source_en: Only then did Shinhichi breathe a sigh of relief. “Please board the boat.”
units.source_zh: 新七这才松了一口气，“请上船吧。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 新七这才松了一口气，“请上船吧。”

paragraphs.source_en: Shinjūrō smiled faintly, the smile touched by a grief that could break the heart. He slowly walked away.

units.source_en: Shinjūrō smiled faintly, the smile touched by a grief that could break the heart.
units.source_zh: 信十郎微微一笑，这笑里带着一抹令人魂断的哀伤。

units.source_en: He slowly walked away.
units.source_zh: 他缓缓走了开去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 信十郎微微一笑，这笑里带着一抹令人魂断的哀伤。他缓缓走了开去。

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord!” Shinhichi called after him. But when he realized where Shinjūrō was going, he too fell silent.

units.source_en: “My lord!”
units.source_zh: “大人！”

units.source_en: Shinhichi called after him.
units.source_zh: 新七喊一声。

units.source_en: But when he realized where Shinjūrō was going, he too fell silent.

ja.t: かおうとしているのか

units.source_zh: 但当他意识到信十郎将要往何处去时，亦便闭了嘴。

paragraphs.source_zh: “大人！”新七喊一声。但当他意识到信十郎将要往何处去时，亦便闭了嘴。

paragraphs.source_en: Beside the storehouse that was close to collapse grew several pittosporum trees over ten feet tall, as well as a few young bodhi trees. Shinjūrō walked straight to the pittosporum trees and suddenly tore off handful after handful of petals. He even pulled up the young bodhi trees, as though slaughtering living creatures.

units.source_en: Beside the storehouse that was close to collapse grew several pittosporum trees over ten feet tall, as well as a few young bodhi trees.
units.source_zh: 快倒塌的仓房旁边，生有几株十尺多高的海桐树，还有几棵菩提树的幼苗。

units.source_en: Shinjūrō walked straight to the pittosporum trees and suddenly tore off handful after handful of petals.
units.source_zh: 信十郎径直走到海桐树旁，突然大把大把扯下花瓣。

units.source_en: He even pulled up the young bodhi trees, as though slaughtering living creatures.

ja.t: しているかのようだった。

units.source_zh: 他甚至薅掉了菩提树的幼苗，有如屠杀生灵。

paragraphs.source_zh: 快倒塌的仓房旁边，生有几株十尺多高的海桐树，还有几棵菩提树的幼苗。信十郎径直走到海桐树旁，突然大把大把扯下花瓣。他甚至薅掉了菩提树的幼苗，有如屠杀生灵。

paragraphs.source_en: Shinhichi was utterly perplexed. Shinjūrō returned, both hands filled with battered flowers and torn leaves. He stared straight ahead, a strange look in his eyes.

units.source_en: Shinhichi was utterly perplexed.
units.source_zh: 新七疑惑不解。

units.source_en: Shinjūrō returned, both hands filled with battered flowers and torn leaves.
units.source_zh: 信十郎已经返回，两手间皆是残花败叶。

units.source_en: He stared straight ahead, a strange look in his eyes.
units.source_zh: 他直望前方，目光古怪。

paragraphs.source_zh: 新七疑惑不解。信十郎已经返回，两手间皆是残花败叶。他直望前方，目光古怪。

paragraphs.source_en: Shinjūrō walked straight toward the earthen graves in the rain. Cradling pittosporum blossoms and tender bodhi leaves, he came to a new grave, stopped, and stood utterly still, his gaze fixed upon the mound. The stench of blood had long since seeped into the earth and vanished into a boundless desolation.

units.source_en: Shinjūrō walked straight toward the earthen graves in the rain.
units.source_zh: 信十郎径朝雨中的土坟走去。

units.source_en: Cradling pittosporum blossoms and tender bodhi leaves, he came to a new grave, stopped, and stood utterly still, his gaze fixed upon the mound.
units.source_zh: 他手捧着海桐花和菩提树嫩叶，来到一座新坟前，停下，立在那里一动不动，目光钉在坟头。

units.source_en: The stench of blood had long since seeped into the earth and vanished into a boundless desolation.
units.source_zh: 血的腥味早已渗入了泥土，消失在无边的茫然之中。

paragraphs.source_zh: 信十郎径朝雨中的土坟走去。他手捧着海桐花和菩提树嫩叶，来到一座新坟前，停下，立在那里一动不动，目光钉在坟头。血的腥味早已渗入了泥土，消失在无边的茫然之中。

paragraphs.source_en: “Fallen leaves return to their roots!” Shinjūrō murmured softly and extended his hands. “May you rest in the earth… Ei!”

units.source_en: “Fallen leaves return to their roots!”
units.source_zh: “落叶归根！”

units.source_en: Shinjūrō murmured softly and extended his hands. “May you rest in the earth… Ei!”
units.source_zh: 信十郎小声叨念一句，手往前伸，“入土为安……呔！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “落叶归根！”信十郎小声叨念一句，手往前伸，“入土为安……呔！”

paragraphs.source_en: Petals and tender leaves scattered down.

units.source_en: Petals and tender leaves scattered down.
units.source_zh: 花瓣和嫩叶纷纷洒落。

paragraphs.source_zh: 花瓣和嫩叶纷纷洒落。

paragraphs.source_en: At the loud cry, several soldiers who remained beside the storehouse started and all looked in his direction. Okuhara Shinjūrō had already turned and withdrawn into the shadows.

units.source_en: At the loud cry, several soldiers who remained beside the storehouse started and all looked in his direction.
units.source_zh: 听见这一声大喝，几个留在仓房旁边的士卒吃了一惊，齐齐朝这边看来。

units.source_en: Okuhara Shinjūrō had already turned and withdrawn into the shadows.
units.source_zh: 奥原信十郎已转身退回暗处。

paragraphs.source_zh: 听见这一声大喝，几个留在仓房旁边的士卒吃了一惊，齐齐朝这边看来。奥原信十郎已转身退回暗处。

paragraphs.source_en: “All right. Cast off.” His voice was exceedingly faint, like a sob.

units.source_en: “All right. Cast off.”
units.source_zh: “好了，开船。”

units.source_en: His voice was exceedingly faint, like a sob.
units.source_zh: 他声音甚是细微，有如啜泣。

paragraphs.source_zh: “好了，开船。”他声音甚是细微，有如啜泣。

paragraphs.source_en: The boat had originally been prepared for Lady Yodo and Hideyori, so they could escape if the worst came to pass. Yet not one of the Kantō soldiers found the vessel suspicious.

units.source_en: The boat had originally been prepared for Lady Yodo and Hideyori, so they could escape if the worst came to pass.
units.source_zh: 此船本乃为淀夫人和秀赖备下的，以备他们万一时出逃之需。

units.source_en: Yet not one of the Kantō soldiers found the vessel suspicious.
units.source_zh: 但是，关东士卒却无一人觉得此舟奇怪。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此船本乃为淀夫人和秀赖备下的，以备他们万一时出逃之需。但是，关东士卒却无一人觉得此舟奇怪。

paragraphs.source_en: Once it was assumed that not a single Toyotomi adherent remained alive, Okuhara Shinjūrō Toyomasa and the retainers he had stationed in various places naturally came to be regarded as men of the Kantō side. He had never especially hated or favored either side; perhaps for that very reason, the change in his allegiance came with perfect naturalness.

units.source_en: Once it was assumed that not a single Toyotomi adherent remained alive, Okuhara Shinjūrō Toyomasa and the retainers he had stationed in various places naturally came to be regarded as men of the Kantō side.
units.source_zh: 丰臣众人已无一个活口，这么一想，奥原信十郎丰政和在他令下伏在各处的家臣，都自然而然变成了关东的人。

units.source_en: He had never especially hated or favored either side; perhaps for that very reason, the change in his allegiance came with perfect naturalness.

ja.t: いてもいなかった。おそらくそのために、

units.source_zh: 他原本就未对任何一方或憎或喜，或许正因如此，他心念的转变亦是自然至极。

paragraphs.source_zh: 丰臣众人已无一个活口，这么一想，奥原信十郎丰政和在他令下伏在各处的家臣，都自然而然变成了关东的人。他原本就未对任何一方或憎或喜，或许正因如此，他心念的转变亦是自然至极。

paragraphs.source_en: As they rowed toward the riverbank, a boat flying Kuki Moritaka’s banner approached, and someone called out, “Saiyū or Aoyama?”

units.source_en: As they rowed toward the riverbank, a boat flying Kuki Moritaka’s banner approached, and someone called out, “Saiyū or Aoyama?”
units.source_zh: 划向河沿的时候，一只插着九鬼守隆旗帜的船划来，有人喝问：“采邑还是青山？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 划向河沿的时候，一只插着九鬼守隆旗帜的船划来，有人喝问：“采邑还是青山？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Saiyū!” Shinhichi shouted back.

units.source_en: “Saiyū!”
units.source_zh: “采邑！”

units.source_en: Shinhichi shouted back.
units.source_zh: 新七大声道。

paragraphs.source_zh: “采邑！”新七大声道。

paragraphs.source_en: Their destination was the house at Hachiken. Many retainers had already gathered on the riverbank to await Okuhara Shinjūrō. Needless to say, the hunt for Osaka’s surviving adherents had begun along the riverbank as well. Men could be seen fighting everywhere, yet scarcely anyone suspected this little boat as it proceeded without a care.

units.source_en: Their destination was the house at Hachiken.
units.source_zh: 他们要去的地方乃是八轩家。

units.source_en: Many retainers had already gathered on the riverbank to await Okuhara Shinjūrō.
units.source_zh: 在河岸，已有很多家人聚在一处，等待奥原信十郎。

units.source_en: Needless to say, the hunt for Osaka’s surviving adherents had begun along the riverbank as well.
units.source_zh: 不必说，河岸上也开始了对大坂余众的追捕。

units.source_en: Men could be seen fighting everywhere, yet scarcely anyone suspected this little boat as it proceeded without a care.

ja.t: はほとんどいなかった。

units.source_zh: 四处均可看到有人交手，但几无人对这无所顾忌的小舟产生怀疑。

paragraphs.source_zh: 他们要去的地方乃是八轩家。在河岸，已有很多家人聚在一处，等待奥原信十郎。不必说，河岸上也开始了对大坂余众的追捕。四处均可看到有人交手，但几无人对这无所顾忌的小舟产生怀疑。

paragraphs.source_en: Aboard the boat, Okuhara Shinjūrō sat with his arms folded, lost in thought.

units.source_en: Aboard the boat, Okuhara Shinjūrō sat with his arms folded, lost in thought.
units.source_zh: 船上，奥原信十郎两手抱胸，陷入沉思。

paragraphs.source_zh: 船上，奥原信十郎两手抱胸，陷入沉思。

paragraphs.source_en: His lord must not be disturbed yet… Unable to conceal the joy in his heart, Shinhichi watched the passing scenery and took care not to interrupt Okuhara Shinjūrō. As Shinhichi saw it, Okuhara Shinjūrō had devoted himself utterly to saving Hideyori and Lady Yodo, only to meet with such an outcome; naturally his heart was heavy.

units.source_en: His lord must not be disturbed yet… Unable to conceal the joy in his heart, Shinhichi watched the passing scenery and took care not to interrupt Okuhara Shinjūrō.
units.source_zh: 现在还不可打扰大人……新七掩饰不住内心的喜悦，看着沿途景色，不敢惊扰了奥原信十郎。

units.source_en: As Shinhichi saw it, Okuhara Shinjūrō had devoted himself utterly to saving Hideyori and Lady Yodo, only to meet with such an outcome; naturally his heart was heavy.

ja.t: くしてきたのに、こんな
となったのだから、つらいのも

units.source_zh: 在他看来，奥原信十郎一心一意要拯救秀赖和淀夫人性命，却得这样一个结果，心里自然难过。

paragraphs.source_zh: 现在还不可打扰大人……新七掩饰不住内心的喜悦，看着沿途景色，不敢惊扰了奥原信十郎。在他看来，奥原信十郎一心一意要拯救秀赖和淀夫人性命，却得这样一个结果，心里自然难过。

paragraphs.source_en: Tenma Bridge came into view ahead, with the figures of townspeople hurrying across it. Everyone knew the fighting was over and was preparing to return home and see to the next day’s livelihood.

units.source_en: Tenma Bridge came into view ahead, with the figures of townspeople hurrying across it.
units.source_zh: 眼前出现了天满桥，桥上可见一些百姓的身影，正急急走过。

units.source_en: Everyone knew the fighting was over and was preparing to return home and see to the next day’s livelihood.
units.source_zh: 人们均知战事已经结束，准备回家打理明日的生计。

paragraphs.source_zh: 眼前出现了天满桥，桥上可见一些百姓的身影，正急急走过。人们均知战事已经结束，准备回家打理明日的生计。

paragraphs.source_en: “Shinhichi.” Shinjūrō Toyomasa suddenly spoke. “Is your mother still in good health?”

units.source_en: “Shinhichi.”
units.source_zh: “新七。”

units.source_en: Shinjūrō Toyomasa suddenly spoke. “Is your mother still in good health?”
units.source_zh: 信十郎丰政突然道，“令堂可还康健？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “新七。”信十郎丰政突然道，“令堂可还康健？”

paragraphs.source_en: “She passed away two years ago.”

units.source_en: “She passed away two years ago.”
units.source_zh: “两年前就已去世了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “两年前就已去世了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Oh. So she is gone.”

units.source_en: “Oh. So she is gone.”
units.source_zh: “哦，已作古了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “哦，已作古了。”
